statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for paroxysmal arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
CPT code 93247 long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring was performed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
